claim_boundary: 已取代 runtime overlay primary；尚未開 public benchmark claim。

complete_flow.name: source intake
complete_flow.rule: 新 skill 只能進 candidate intake；不得直接 runtime mount

complete_flow.name: capability bucket
complete_flow.rule: 先映射到 Nexus 新路由能力分類，再進同能力候選池

complete_flow.name: paired compare
complete_flow.rule: Flash+Nexus without skill vs Flash+Nexus+skill；比較 delivery/trust/token/wall/receipt

complete_flow.name: catalog verdict
complete_flow.rule: 寫入 capability-skill catalog；產生 primary/alternate/reject

complete_flow.name: replacement approval
complete_flow.rule: 由 evidence-approved apply review 判定，不由人工喜好挑選

complete_flow.name: runtime replacement
complete_flow.rule: V8 runtime overlay 寫入 primary_skill_by_capability，runtime resolver 載入後即以新 skill 為 primary

complete_flow.name: post-apply smoke
complete_flow.rule: runtime-final receipt 再確認四個 primary 都有 contract，且 violation=0

complete_flow.name: ledger
complete_flow.rule: applied_primary / held_alternate / rejected 分流落帳

complete_flow.name: future replacement loop
complete_flow.rule: 新 skill 若勝出，重走 1-9；勝出後替換 overlay primary 並追加 ledger

future_skill_replacement_rule: 同能力候選比較，不跨 capability 混選
challenger 必須先贏 current primary 的 paired compare
challenger 必須通過 seal 與 post-apply smoke
勝出後更新 overlay primary，舊 primary 移到 held_alternate 或 rejected
每次替換必須追加 replacement ledger，不覆寫歷史
replacement_statement: SF V8 已取代 runtime overlay primary skill；runtime resolver 載入 V8 overlay 後即使用新配對。
